data.title: 春原瞬 · 私家温泉的白汽红晕回首
data.description: 隐秘竹林私汤内泉水滚烫，水面上漂着初绽的梅花花瓣。瞬浸在清澈的水波中，双手轻搭在池边岩石上。湿润的长长黑发贴在白玉般滑腻的脊背上，蒸汽将她成熟妩媚的面庞蒸得如桃花般绯红娇艳。虎耳垂在水雾中轻颤，她侧过脸颊回首凝视，绿色眼眸中满是令人心醉的缠绵情意。
data.location: private outdoor hot spring surrounded by plum blossom trees and bamboo
data.action: 虎耳垂在水雾中轻颤，她侧过脸颊回首凝视，绿色眼眸中满是令人心醉的缠绵情意
data.lighting: warm lantern glow piercing through rising steam and night air
data.camera: from behind, three quarter view, cowboy shot
data.promptProse: In a secluded outdoor hot spring bordered by dark bamboo and floating plum blossoms, Shun rests her hands on the smooth poolside rocks and turns back over her shoulder with a warm, captivating gaze under moonlight and lantern glow.
data.animaCaption: Soaking nude in a steaming bamboo-ringed private hot spring scattered with drifting plum petals under moonlight, she rests both hands on the wet stone rim and glances back over her bare wet shoulder with flushed, affectionate eyes.
data.nsfwProse: Completely unclothed in the steaming clear hot spring up to her chest, wet hair clings along her bare flushed back and bare shoulders.
